# The Student Athlete Foundation (SAF Golf)

> Houston-area 501(c)(3) nonprofit (legal name: JJ Wood Student Athlete Foundation Inc., EIN 45-3459562) funding need-based scholarship access to the Varsity junior golf coaching program delivered at Golf Performance Group, Timber Creek Golf Club, Friendswood, Texas.

Families apply based on financial need; available funding and eligibility review determine awards. Donations to SAF are separate from paid Golf Performance Group or PGACOACH purchases. History: college golf combines and showcases since 2012; complimentary veterans and amputee programs with PGA HOPE beginning 2016; past scholarships through the Southern Texas PGA and Beltway Junior Golf Tour; equipment for underfunded high-school teams. Founder JJ Wood is a PGA professional and former assistant coach at Rice University and Ohio State.
